implementation: Fixed-cardinality histogram registry, explicit shared Outcome enum and trace reports; no identities/text as metric labels.
Read-only persistent state/money aggregates keep unknown cost/reservations explicit.
Bounded recent diagnostic correlations omit free log/exception text, chat, credentials, browser state and database files.
Online /api/v1/system/metrics and /system/diagnostics; UI logs panel and v12 own resource group.
Exclusive offline read-only CLI diagnostics; no service start, database upgrade or existing-file overwrite.
Diagnostic I/O capacity remains charged after requester cancellation; shutdown retains storage/lock until real work ends.
OpenTelemetry automatic exception payload capture disabled; only result enum and exception type recorded.
Boot/Agent/capture-bound debug: 3600s, global 128MiB, fixed metadata only, same writer/queue, 24h owned-file expiry; explicit audit on requested/started/failed/stopped.
Audit failure prevents activation or immediately stops capture; expiry/stop audit retries while storage/lock stay owned.
Owner HTTP/workbench debug control and bounded per-capture cursor query; stale/cross-Agent/previous-boot control rejected.
Ordinary log reads now use the same managed diagnostic I/O; cancelled request never releases an actual in-progress worker.
Private atomic no-overwrite export with exact ZIP members, CRC, compressed/uncompressed caps; raw identity HTTP streams only.
Redaction covers nested keys; bounded registry refuses new unprotected secrets without evicting old ones.
Idle normal-log expiry runs every minute; unrelated files preserved; expired cursors are explicit.

development_failures.reason: New diagnostic UI test invoked fake model before configuring its profile. Added ordinary UI profile setup; reply/private-data/debug assertions retained.
Windows DirEntry fast-path link count was zero; use Path.stat for actual identity. Failed cases and final regression retained.
ZIP bytes created at import contained current timestamps, causing nondeterministic parameter IDs across workers. Construct payloads inside stable named cases. Final full rerun validates all tests.
